prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object seen, approach it. Else scan for object. Reach, grasp & place it in zone. Check properties. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = PlaceObjectInArea    /> <Action ID = ReachForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsRobotApproachingObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInSight    /> <Action ID = MovementToApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObjectPlacementArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGrasped    /> <Action ID = ApproachToObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsRobotApproachingObject? THEN
			DO ReachForObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectGrasped? THEN
			DO MoveToObjectPlacementArea
	ELSE
		DO PlaceObjectInArea
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
